dataset.name: Jezero CTX numerical terrain
dataset.processing: Native grid, no elevation resampling. Invalid sentinel and nonfinite cells masked. Centred finite differences; edge derivatives one-sided. Slope unavailable next to missing terrain. Little-endian float32 arrays.
limitations: 20 m projected grid does not resolve rocks or guarantee traversability.
High-resolution imagery is not high-resolution elevation.
Grid slope and edge grade do not capture every hazard.
